card.name: Beth in synagogue names
card.fires_on: The word Beth beginning a synagogue or congregation name (Beth Israel, Beth Ahabah, Beth Shalome). Weaker on a few other name-starting words and on a shell prompt # before a command.

modes.label: Beth in congregation names
modes.description: Beth starts the name of a Jewish congregation or hospital, right before Israel, Ahabah or Shalome.
modes.example: Newark<< Beth>> Israel Medical Center in Newark, New Jersey

modes.label: Other name or command starts
modes.description: Weaker cases: a word inside an organization name, or the # prompt before a Unix command.
modes.example: #disklabel -rw /dev/rfd0a floppy3 Creating a small filesystem optimized for space: <<#>>newfs -m 0 -o

card.plain: It lights up on the word Beth at the start of a synagogue name, such as Beth Israel.
